status: Proposed implementation/extracted-test inputs; not executed tests or browser observations.

cases.name: author-absolute-over-ua
cases.setup: Author absolute 20/30px; lower normal UA system-font and appearance-base inherit declarations.
cases.required_result: Allow only after actual reached prefix/readset validation; lower declarations cannot displace winner.
cases.purpose: Source-supported fixture shape; native prefix not captured.

cases.name: higher-skipped-base
cases.setup: Higher APPEARANCE_BASE declaration currently skipped; lower absolute selected.
cases.required_result: Pending/reject certificate even if current winner is absolute.

cases.name: rollback-base-read
cases.setup: Reached revert/revert-layer chain with an earlier skipped flag-dependent candidate.
cases.required_result: Retain rollback reads and reject unstable prefix.

cases.name: later-lower-base
cases.setup: Unflagged absolute winner before lower base-only rule.
cases.required_result: Lower unvisited rule does not itself invalidate certificate.

cases.name: unzoom-before-set
cases.setup: Inherited zoomed sizes; final selected XTS None and absolute size.
cases.required_result: Actual inherited unzoom once, then actual FontSize conversion/setter/hooks once; deferred drain must not unzoom fresh size.

cases.name: unchanged-or-absent-xts
cases.setup: No XTS declaration, or inherited equal XTS value.
cases.required_result: Follow actual seen/default path; do not manufacture an application or second unzoom.

cases.name: textzoom-and-effectivezoom
cases.setup: Nonidentity text zoom and effective zoom; absolute non-px unit.
cases.required_result: Use real property conversion/quantization, not to_px_if_absolute as final value.

cases.name: min-size-zero
cases.setup: Absolute zero with nonzero minimum font preference/ratio.
cases.required_result: Preserve zero early return and computed/used distinction.

cases.name: min-size-positive
cases.setup: Absolute size below language-dependent minimum, final XLang and ratio.
cases.required_result: Computed size remains absolute conversion; used font size is clamped by actual hook.
cases.purpose: No metric readiness from computed-size alone.

cases.name: default-fontsize
cases.setup: No FontSize declaration; Initial/Inherit/Unset; keyword/math/relative/system branches.
cases.required_result: Unsupported bounded facet remains Pending; no absolute/None-keyword inference.

cases.name: facet-not-complete
cases.setup: Unit consumer requests computed size while ordinary FontSize and metric consumers remain pending.
cases.required_result: Only typed unit reply proceeds; generic Complete/ensured/full completion must remain false.

cases.name: flag-reset-retirement
cases.setup: Appearance changes flags after facet consumed; session requests reset before ordinary node retires.
cases.required_result: Prove recorded prefix/readset stability; retain or transfer owned certificate without stale indices; no reset assertion weakening or reapplication.
